title: 8 Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) Solutions: Our Top Picks by Use Case (2026)
content_md: Microsoft Intune scores highest in our 2026 evaluation, largely because most organizations reading this already own it it ships with Microsoft 365 E3 and E5. Omnissa leads on cross-platform depth, ManageEngine on published pricing, and Baramundi and Matrix42 serve European buyers with requirements the global vendors handle less directly. Here are eight platforms scored, matched to the buyer each genuinely serves. To build a defense-in-depth posture, modern enterprises pair UEM with XDR solutions and round-the-clock protection from MDR companies to detect and mitigate advanced threats targeting endpoint environments. Best UEM by Use Case — At a Glance Your situation Our pick Score Microsoft 365 E3 or E5 estate Microsoft Intune 8.7 Large cross-platform enterprise Omnissa (Workspace ONE) 8.4 Mid-market wanting published pricing ManageEngine 8.3 Legacy Windows plus modern management Ivanti 7.8 German-speaking Europe, Windows-heavy Baramundi 7.6 European, service-management integration Matrix42 7.3 Existing Sophos security estate Sophos Mobile 7.0 Citrix workspace environment Citrix Verify status first Definitional answer: unified endpoint management manages and secures all endpoint types Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, and increasingly IoT from a single console, handling configuration, application deployment, patching, security policy, and compliance enforcement.
